mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateKey, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%c월 %d일') as displayDate, COUNT(m.message_id) as conversationCount, MAX(ec.emotion_name) as dominantEmotion, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(m.created_at), '%H:%i') as minTime, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(m.created_at), '%H:%i') as maxTime, MAX(rs.name) as recommendedAction FROM MESSAGE m JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON m.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id LEFT JOIN CHAT_ANALYSIS_SESSION cas ON cas.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id AND m.message_id BETWEEN cas.start_message_id AND cas.end_message_id LEFT JOIN MESSAGE_ANALYSIS ma ON ma.session_id = cas.session_id LEFT JOIN EMOTION_CATEGORY ec ON ma.emotion_id = ec.emotion_id LEFT JOIN RESPONSE_STRATEGY rs ON ma.risk_level = rs.risk_level WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%c월 %d일') ORDER BY dateKey DESC

SELECT m.message_id as id, LOWER(COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.senderType')), 'USER')) as role, CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.content, '$.senderType')), 'USER')) = 'USER' THEN '나' ELSE '메이티' END as name, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%p %h:%i') as time FROM MESSAGE m JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON m.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{dateKey} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT b.name as botKey, COUNT(cr.chat_room_id) as chatCount FROM CHAT_ROOM cr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id JOIN BOT b ON e.bot_id = b.bot_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY b.bot_id, b.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MESSAGE_ANALYSIS ( emotion_id, session_id, risk_level, analyzed_at ) VALUES ( #{dominantEmotionId}, ( SELECT cas.session_id FROM CHAT_ANALYSIS_SESSION cas WHERE #{messageId} BETWEEN cas.start_message_id AND cas.end_message_id ORDER BY cas.session_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), COALESCE(#{riskLevel}, 1), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT ma.analysis_id as analysisId, cas.end_message_id as messageId, ma.emotion_id as dominantEmotionId, NULL as riskLevel, NULL as isHighRisk, rs.name as recommendedAction, ma.analyzed_at as analyzedAt FROM MESSAGE_ANALYSIS ma JOIN CHAT_ANALYSIS_SESSION cas ON ma.session_id = cas.session_id JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON cas.chat_room_id = cr.chat_room_id JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON cr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id LEFT JOIN RESPONSE_STRATEGY rs ON ma.risk_level = rs.risk_level WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ma.analyzed_at DESC

SELECT analysis_id as analysisId, NULL as messageId, emotion_id as dominantEmotionId, NULL as riskLevel, NULL as isHighRisk, NULL as recommendedAction, analyzed_at as analyzedAt FROM MESSAGE_ANALYSIS WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
